name: Dubin Orthodontics
what_they_do: Family-owned orthodontic practice operating since 1976 with three offices (1648 US-130 North Brunswick, 85 Raritan Ave Highland Park, 1600 Perrineville Rd Monroe Township). Treatments are metal and clear braces for children and adults, Invisalign, Empower self-ligating appliances and early treatment, with iTero digital impressions and surgical orthodontics also listed.
customers: Families with children needing braces plus adults seeking Invisalign across Middlesex County, Highland Park and Monroe Township; insurance-accepting and financed patients.

size_signals.signal: Three office locations listed in the header and footer of every page
'FAMILY OWNED & SERVING THE COMMUNITY SINCE 1976' hero statement; single named doctor, Dr. Joseph Dubin
Has an Online Payment portal and Patient Login, plus a post-appointment survey page - signs of an established, systemised practice

listing.reviews: Google count not displayed in the limited logged-out Maps view

website_review.primary_cta: Three equal buttons above the hero: 'Appointment Request', 'Online Payment', 'Patient Login'
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Request-only. The appointment form (office, name, email, phone, comment) says a scheduling coordinator will contact you to confirm; no live availability. Google profile shows a 'Book online' button that lands on that request page.
website_review.trust_signals: 50 years in business, doctor photo and bio, before/after gallery, office tour, testimonials page, insurance page, financial information, Invisalign and Empower brand pages
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Pages are image-heavy (home screenshot alone was ~800KB at phone width); no review rating shown anywhere on site; the three CTAs bury the one action (request an appointment) among payment and login
website_review.search_basics: Titles and descriptions name orthodontics + the three towns; ~15 treatment and patient pages; but the home page has zero structured data (no JSON-LD at all) so hours, locations and services are unstructured
top_issues: No schema.org markup on any page reviewed
Booking is a callback request, not a calendar
Heavy images; no visible reviews or ratings on the site

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt only blocks CMS folders, so Googlebot/OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot are welcome, and the GBP is complete enough to show category, hours and a 'Book online' button. Answerable: office addresses and phone are text, but hours are not stated on the home page, prices/financing detail is thin, and script[type=application/ld+json] returned 0 nodes on both the home page and the appointment page - so nothing machine-readable confirms location or services. Bookable: an appointment-request form with proper labels exists and is one click from the header, but it only produces a callback.

operations_signals.signal: New-patient intake still runs on downloadable PDF registration forms (adult, child, HIPAA in English and Spanish) that staff must key in
Appointment requests are confirmed by a human scheduling coordinator, and the form explicitly redirects cancellations to a phone call
Three offices share one scheduling coordinator and eight pages of patient instructions, a routing and reminder load (inference from the shared contact block)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness/Dentist JSON-LD for all three offices and put hours, insurance and price ranges in text - right now the site is completely unmarked up and an agent cannot reliably answer 'when are you open in North Brunswick'
top_opportunities.evidence: document.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]') returned an empty NodeList on the home page and appointment page

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the callback-request form with real online scheduling (Invisalign consults, new-patient exams) per office, so a patient's agent can book and reschedule without waiting for the coordinator
top_opportunities.evidence: Form text: 'Our scheduling coordinator will contact you soon to confirm your appointment'; cancellations must be phoned in; GBP already advertises 'Book online' and lands on this form

top_opportunities.opportunity: Digitise new-patient intake (replace the four PDFs with an online form that writes into the practice management system) and automate reminders across three offices
top_opportunities.evidence: Patient Forms page links adult, child and HIPAA PDFs for print-and-fill

scores.reasons: Gap: professional-looking site with a clear story and 50 years of trust, but zero structured data, callback-only booking and PDF intake. Pay: three-office orthodontic practice with high-ticket treatment plans, insurance and financing - the most obvious budget here. Ease: adding schema and swapping in a scheduler is a short, well-bounded engagement. Evidence: reviewed home, appointment-request, patient-forms pages, robots.txt, mobile layout and Google profile.
